items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: And we had Black Benny, me and him and the band with her. He was a good drummer.

ctx.x: Well you know there's Red Happy now, that's the one you're talking about. But there's another one, plays with the Eureka now?

Well Happy, this Happy is not here now. Yeah. He used to play, he was about one of the next drummers. See what I mean, after Chani. And we had Black Benny, me and him and the band with her. He was a good drummer.
